thought: Ge Zhenlin is the vice squad leader and an experienced veteran - one of the two survivors. Comparing with others: Ma Baoyu is tall and lean with binoculars; Song Xueyi has a simple/honest face; the Hu brothers are cheerful. Ge Zhenlin's description emphasizes 'sturdy/robust build' and 'prominent jawline' - these are his key physical differentiators. As a veteran and hands-on fighter (not the tactical observer like Ma Baoyu), his distinctive features should convey experience and physical strength. The most effective distinctive markers: 1) Stocky, muscular build (contrasts directly with Ma Baoyu's lean frame), 2) Prominent square jawline (explicitly mentioned in description), 3) Rolled-up sleeves showing muscular forearms (practical for a veteran fighter, shows he's action-oriented). These combined features make him immediately recognizable as the strong, experienced second-in-command.
distinctive_features: Stocky, muscular build with prominent square jawline, rolled-up sleeves exposing muscular forearms, weathered veteran appearance
prompt: Full body portrait of a stocky, muscular Eighth Route Army vice squad leader standing in a solid, grounded stance. The man has a distinctively prominent square jawline that conveys tenacity and authority, with a weathered, honest face showing years of combat experience. Most notably, his uniform sleeves are rolled up to his elbows, exposing strong, muscular forearms that emphasize his hands-on, battle-hardened nature. He wears a blue-gray Eighth Route Army uniform jacket with sleeves rolled up, standard military cap with red star emblem, brown leather belt with grenade pouch at his side, dark cotton pants, and sturdy cloth shoes. A rifle is held diagonally across his chest in a ready position. Centered composition, symmetrical framing, eye-level angle. The subject stands against a single colored deep charcoal gray background with high contrast separation. Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting from the front-right, creating strong shadows that accentuate his square jawline and muscular build, with highlights on his exposed forearms. Cool to neutral color temperature with low-saturation earth tones - muted slate blues, weathered grays, dusty olive. The lighting emphasizes the texture of his weathered skin and the solid mass of his physique. Solemn, steadfast, and resilient atmosphere reflecting a veteran soldier's unwavering resolve in 1941 wartime China. Realistic, thick-painted 2D animation style with bold, visible brushstrokes and strong value contrast between light and shadow areas, emphasizing the harsh dignity and epic gravitas of historical warfare. Deep focus maintaining sharpness throughout the entire figure from head to toe. Non-distorted portrait lens with natural perspective. The overall mood conveys veteran experience, physical strength, calm precision, and unshakeable determination. Cultural portraiture, historically accurate 1941 Chinese Eighth Route Army uniform and equipment, realistic rendering with painterly texture.
ref_description: Stocky, muscular soldier with rolled-up sleeves and prominent square jawline
